item.title: [Daily FT - Business/Sectors] 2027 Appropriation Bill sets Rs. 4.99 t Vote on Account, borrowing capped at Rs. 3.8 t
item.description: The Appropriation Bill for the 2027 financial year has been published in the Government Gazette, setting out an estimated Rs. 4.99 trillion in service expenditure for Government Ministries and Departments and capping net Government borrowings for the year at Rs. 3.8 trillion.

item.title: [Daily FT - Business/Sectors] Tea exports dip 5% in August
item.description: Tea exports during the first eight months of 2026 have declined by 5% year-on-year, with shipments continuing to be affected by higher freight and insurance costs and access disruptions in key markets.

item.title: [Daily FT - Business/Sectors] China firm wins Rs. 22 b Muthurajawela fuel terminal contract
item.description: China Petroleum Pipeline Engineering Company Ltd., has been awarded a contract worth $ 40.84 million and Rs. 8.5 billion to develop a new aviation fuel storage and distribution facility at Muthurajawela, Cabinet Spokesman Dr. Nalinda Jayatissa said yesterday. The total project is valued at approximately Rs. 22.2 billion.

item.title: [Daily FT - Business/Sectors] Anti-Corruption Bill clauses on bail and remand requires Referendum: SC
item.description: Speaker Dr. Jagath Wickramaratne yesterday informed Parliament that the Supreme Court has determined that two clauses of the Anti-Corruption (Amendment) Bill are inconsistent with the Constitution.
